<a id="schema-registerrequest"></a>
### RegisterRequest

Request model for user registration containing all required user information

Required: `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `userName`, `password`, `confirmPassword`, `activateUser`, `autoConfirmEmail`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `firstName` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's first name; minLength 1 |
| `lastName` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's last name; minLength 1 |
| `email` | string (email) | yes | Gets or sets the user's email address (used for login and communications); minLength 1 |
| `userName` | string | yes | Gets or sets the unique username for the account (minimum 6 characters); minLength 6 |
| `password` | string | yes | Gets or sets the user's password (minimum 6 characters); minLength 6 |
| `confirmPassword` | string | yes | Gets or sets the password confirmation (must match Password); minLength 1 |
| `phoneNumber` | string |  | Gets or sets the user's phone number (optional) |
| `activateUser` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user account should be activated immediately upon registration |
| `autoConfirmEmail` | boolean | yes | Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user's email should be auto-confirmed (bypassing email verification) |
